answer.answer: ST-EVA records multiple disagreements for AAPL where different filings report different values for the same metric, period, and source concept. The system has not selected a winner in any case (resolution: NO_WINNER_SELECTED). The competing values are: (1) net_income FY2007 (2006-10-01 to 2007-09-29): 3,496,000,000 vs 3,495,000,000; (2) revenue FY2007: 24,006,000,000 vs 24,578,000,000; (3) assets 2008-09-27: 39,572,000,000 vs 36,171,000,000; (4) eps_diluted FY2008 (2007-09-30 to 2008-09-27): 5.36 vs 6.78; (5) net_income FY2008: 4,834,000,000 vs 6,119,000,000; (6) revenue FY2008: 32,479,000,000 vs 37,491,000,000; (7) eps_diluted 2008-09-28 to 2009-06-27: 4.47 vs 6.3; (8) eps_diluted Q3 2009 (2009-03-29 to 2009-06-27): 1.35 vs 2.01; (9) net_income 2008-09-28 to 2009-06-27: 4,039,000,000 vs 5,703,000,000; (10) net_income Q3 2009: 1,229,000,000 vs 1,828,000,000; (11) revenue 2008-09-28 to 2009-06-27: 26,667,000,000 vs 30,698,000,000. In each case the reason is NOT_EXPLAINED: the source endpoint aggregates dimension members without returning the member, so the aggregate is not identifiable from the evidence held. ST-EVA does not know which value is correct and has not chosen.
uncertainties: Which filing represents the correct restated or amended value in each disagreement
